content: Keystroke-dynamics literature splits dwell (keydown-to-keyup of one key) from flight/IKI (intervals between two keys: UD, DU, DD, UU). Median is the robust aggregator. keebdrill's existing slowestFive already measures consecutive-record gaps (DD analog over charLog). Heatmap should use non-repeat keydown-to-keydown IKI attributed to the arriving code, excluding modifiers as both samples and prevTMs so Shift+key does not collapse latency.
